name: Kepler-90
description: Star of 6,080 K, 848 parsecs away, with 8 transiting planets.

radius.source: Cabrera et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KOI-351 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: 8 planets cross Kepler-90 as seen from Earth: b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Cabrera et al. 2014.

quotes.title: Kepler-90
quotes.card: Kepler-90, also designated 2MASS J18574403+4918185, is an F-type star located about 2,790 light-years (855 pc) from Earth in the constellation of Draco.
quotes.introduction: It is notable for being the only confirmed planetary system with the same number of observed planets as the Solar System.
